question: Code Generation Baseline: How frequently do you or your team use AI to generate code (functions, classes, or modules)?
choice_a: Rarely or Never: We primarily write code manually or use traditional snippets/templates.
choice_b: Occasionally: We experiment with AI suggestions but don't rely on them regularly.
choice_c: Frequently: AI-generated code is used for many routine tasks or boilerplate sections.
choice_d: Extensively: AI is our primary method for initial code generation across most features.

question: Review Loop & Accuracy: When AI generates a significant block of code, how much manual 'fixing' is typically required?
choice_a: Heavy Intervention: I rarely use the output as-is; it usually requires significant manual rewriting to make it functional or compliant.
choice_b: Iterative Prompting: The first output is often a 'hallucination' or slightly off, requiring 2-3 follow-up prompts to get the desired result.
choice_c: Minor Polishing: The output is 80-90% correct; I usually just need to fix variable names or minor logic to match our project style.
choice_d: Near-Seamless Acceptance: The output is almost always correct and ready for PR after a quick validation, requiring little to no manual code changes.

question: Context Awareness: How well does the AI understand your existing codebase when generating new code?
choice_a: Limited Context: AI suggestions often don't align with our architecture, naming conventions, or patterns.
choice_b: Basic Understanding: AI catches some patterns but frequently misses project-specific conventions.
choice_c: Good Integration: AI suggestions usually match our coding style and architectural patterns.
choice_d: Excellent Alignment: AI consistently generates code that feels native to our codebase, including edge cases.

question: Complex Logic Handling: How effective is AI at generating complex business logic or algorithms?
choice_a: Not Suitable: We avoid using AI for anything beyond simple CRUD operations.
choice_b: Limited Success: AI can handle simple logic but struggles with complex business rules.
choice_c: Moderately Effective: AI can generate complex logic with some guidance and iteration.
choice_d: Highly Capable: AI reliably generates sophisticated algorithms and business logic correctly.

question: Test Generation: How extensively do you use AI to generate unit tests, integration tests, or test cases?
choice_a: Not at All: We write all tests manually without AI assistance.
choice_b: Experimental: We've tried AI-generated tests but don't use them in production.
choice_c: Regular Use: AI generates many of our tests, which we review and refine.
choice_d: Primary Method: AI-generated tests form the foundation of our test suite with minimal manual additions.

question: Test Coverage Quality: How comprehensive and effective are AI-generated tests?
choice_a: Poor Coverage: AI tests miss critical edge cases and scenarios.
choice_b: Basic Coverage: AI covers happy paths but requires manual additions for edge cases.
choice_c: Good Coverage: AI generates thorough tests with most edge cases covered.
choice_d: Excellent Coverage: AI-generated tests are comprehensive and catch issues we might have missed.

question: Bug Detection: How effective is AI at identifying and fixing bugs in existing code?
choice_a: Not Useful: We don't use AI for bug detection or fixing.
choice_b: Occasional Help: AI sometimes spots obvious issues but misses subtle bugs.
choice_c: Valuable Tool: AI regularly identifies bugs and suggests fixes that work with minor adjustments.
choice_d: Critical Asset: AI catches bugs earlier and more reliably than manual reviews alone.

question: Code Review Assistance: How much does AI contribute to your code review process?
choice_a: No AI Involvement: Code reviews are entirely manual.
choice_b: Basic Linting: AI provides style and syntax checks only.
choice_c: Substantive Input: AI flags logic issues, security concerns, and suggests improvements.
choice_d: Integrated Partner: AI reviews are a standard part of our process, catching issues before human review.

question: Security Analysis: How does AI help identify security vulnerabilities?
choice_a: Not Used: We rely on traditional security scanning tools only.
choice_b: Supplementary: AI provides additional security insights but isn't relied upon.
choice_c: Important Layer: AI security analysis is part of our standard workflow.
choice_d: Primary Scanner: AI is our first line of defense for identifying security issues.

question: Code Documentation: How do you use AI to generate code comments and documentation?
choice_a: Manual Only: All documentation is written manually without AI assistance.
choice_b: Basic Summaries: AI generates simple function descriptions that we heavily edit.
choice_c: Standard Practice: AI generates comprehensive documentation that needs minor refinement.
choice_d: Automated Pipeline: AI documentation is generated automatically and rarely requires changes.

question: Knowledge Base Creation: How does AI help with creating or maintaining technical documentation?
choice_a: Not Applicable: We don't use AI for documentation beyond code comments.
choice_b: Draft Generation: AI creates initial drafts that we substantially rewrite.
choice_c: Collaborative Tool: AI-generated docs form a solid foundation with some editing.
choice_d: Primary Author: AI generates comprehensive documentation that's production-ready.

question: Code Explanation: How effectively can AI explain complex code to team members?
choice_a: Not Used: Team members explain code to each other directly.
choice_b: Basic Help: AI provides surface-level explanations that miss important details.
choice_c: Helpful Resource: AI explanations are accurate and help team members understand code.
choice_d: Expert Tutor: AI provides insightful explanations that enhance team understanding significantly.

question: API Documentation: How does AI assist in generating and maintaining API documentation?
choice_a: Manual Process: All API docs are written and maintained manually.
choice_b: Template Generation: AI creates basic API doc templates we fill in.
choice_c: Automated Generation: AI generates comprehensive API docs from code with minor edits.
choice_d: Fully Integrated: API documentation is automatically generated and synced with code changes.

question: Development Speed: How has AI affected your overall development velocity?
choice_a: No Impact: Development speed remains unchanged with AI tools.
choice_b: Marginal Improvement: Slight speed increase (5-15%) in specific tasks only.
choice_c: Significant Boost: 20-40% faster development across most features.
choice_d: Transformative: 50%+ productivity gain, fundamentally changed our development process.

question: Learning Curve: How easy was it for your team to adopt AI coding tools?
choice_a: Very Difficult: Significant training and adjustment period required.
choice_b: Moderate Challenge: Took several weeks for team to become comfortable.
choice_c: Relatively Easy: Most team members were productive within days.
choice_d: Seamless: Team adapted immediately with minimal friction.

question: Refactoring Support: How does AI help with code refactoring and modernization?
choice_a: Not Reliable: We avoid using AI for refactoring due to consistency concerns.
choice_b: Limited Help: AI can handle simple refactoring but not architectural changes.
choice_c: Effective Tool: AI successfully handles most refactoring tasks with guidance.
choice_d: Powerful Accelerator: AI executes complex refactoring across entire codebases reliably.

question: Cross-Language Support: How well does AI handle multiple programming languages in your stack?
choice_a: Single Language Focus: AI only works well with our primary language.
choice_b: Variable Quality: AI performance varies significantly across languages.
choice_c: Consistent Support: AI handles all our languages reasonably well.
choice_d: Polyglot Expert: AI excels across all languages and frameworks we use.

question: Team Collaboration: How has AI impacted collaboration and knowledge sharing?
choice_a: Negative Impact: AI has created inconsistency or reduced knowledge sharing.
choice_b: Neutral: No significant change in collaboration patterns.
choice_c: Positive Effect: AI helps standardize practices and share knowledge more effectively.
choice_d: Transformative: AI has fundamentally improved how our team collaborates and learns.

question: Future Outlook: What are your expectations for AI in development over the next year?
choice_a: Skeptical: We don't expect AI to significantly change our workflow.
choice_b: Cautiously Optimistic: We'll continue experimenting but with limited expectations.
choice_c: Confident: We plan to expand AI usage into more areas of development.
choice_d: Fully Committed: AI will be central to our development strategy going forward.
